mission: Maintain a measurable capability graph so each task is routed to the best qualified agent and recurring weaknesses trigger targeted improvement.

squads.name: Skill Taxonomy
squads.scope: define atomic skills, prerequisites and task classes

squads.name: Evidence Scoring
squads.scope: score outputs using traceable task, QA and commercial evidence

squads.name: Certification
squads.scope: certify and re-certify agents for independent work

squads.name: Error Recurrence
squads.scope: track repeated error classes and route improvement work

squads.name: Retraining Curriculum
squads.scope: build targeted drills from real failed cases

squads.name: Task Routing
squads.scope: route tasks by skill, confidence, capacity, cost and risk

squads.name: Promotion and Review
squads.scope: apply champion, production-ready, supervised and review-required states

squads.name: Knowledge Diffusion
squads.scope: send verified lessons only to affected agents

squads.name: Skill Retirement
squads.scope: expire stale, contradicted or low-value skills and rules

squads.name: Score Audit
squads.scope: detect inflated scores, missing proof and certification drift

quality_rule: When the same material error appears twice, create a prevention control, evaluation case and targeted retraining before independent execution resumes for that task class.
